objective: Determine whether cross-family continuous ranking fails because of nuisance dimensions, missing nonlinear features, or the OI score itself.

head_models.expanded_quadratic_screening: Select eight target-covariant quadratic seed terms in the supplied metric scale, close their coordinates under degree-two products, then standardize selected coordinates for Ridge.

selector_gates.survival: A method survives only if every selector gate passes and every reference panel is valid.

execution.sharding: panel ordinal modulo shard count; finalization requires every frozen checkpoint

interpretation.observed_to_signal: Improvement after removing nuisance identifies metric contamination.
interpretation.signal_to_lift: Improvement only after degree-two lifting identifies missing nonlinear representation.
interpretation.lift_failure: Failure on the sufficient lifted view identifies score or aggregation misalignment across relation families.
interpretation.head_proxy: Existing screened heads are a narrow diagnostic; expanded heads add two linear coordinates and diagonal quadratic terms.
interpretation.no_promotion: This synthetic mechanism diagnostic cannot promote or tune a method.
